user.title: Add a Packstation
user.description: Enter the postal code of the station and its Packstation number. No DHL account is required. Free compartment data may not be available at every station.

error.invalid_location: Enter a five-digit postal code and a Packstation number with one to four digits.
error.station_not_found: DHL did not return this exact Packstation. Check the postal code of the station and its number.
error.invalid_response: DHL returned unexpected data. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: DHL could not be reached or is limiting requests. Try again later.

init.title: Data freshness
init.description: Counts become unavailable when the DHL observation reaches this age. Requests run every 15 minutes.
